limitations: Depth-changing approaches are deliberate map transfers along supported physical routes.
Point samples are not swept-body or owner-play acceptance.
navigationDecision: One foreshortened stair landing shows the climb into depth. UP transfers to the Churchyard; no chain of dead stair screens and no initial fast travel.
cameraRule: Default -17.5 degrees. Wide screens use 28m camera standoff and narrower optical field; Praca uses a modest -10-degree exception with physical roof clearance.
navigationDoorDecision: Every town screen shows its authored solid 3D arrow model by default; one persistent Options toggle hides arrow models while retaining prompts and interactions.
interactionRule: Event direction owns marker, input and prompt. away=UP, toward=DOWN; left/right continue along the street. Interior returns face the foreground and use DOWN. Screen camera rotation can change the same path's verb across a transfer.
pracaDecision: Separate frontages retain solid 3D arrows. The main stair approach turns toward the camera; the visible service ladder provides an optional upward shortcut to the churchyard.
